vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are committed as fix(deps), whatever the dependency, so Release Please cuts a release that carries them. Otherwise an indirect dependency's fix is a chore and waits for the next release. They are proposed at once, rather than after the few days other releases wait, which Renovate does by default and is said here so that it stays so.

customManagers.description: Images Go code runs, such as the Chrome the browser tests drive, named in a string under a renovate comment.
Tools workflows install by version, such as the linter, named on the line under a renovate comment.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves, by GitHub's auto-merge, once the checks main requires have passed, the browser tests among them.
echo-otel's major version tracks Echo's, so the two move together in one PR, whatever their major version.

A release must be a few days old before it is proposed, long enough for most hijacked ones to be caught and pulled, as minor and patch updates merge themselves. pnpm refuses younger libraries too; see web/pnpm-workspace.yaml. Security fixes are proposed at once.
Alpine's morph plugin must match Alpine's own version, so the two move together in one PR.
htmx 4 is a rewrite, with new event names and a new extension API, which the morph extension in layout.gohtml is written against. Moving to it is a piece of work, not an update.
